title: Scots pine drought/recovery: public-data mapping benchmark

target_trial.population: One-year nursery Scots pine seedlings after pre-existing inoculum exposure
target_trial.eligibility: Alive potted seedlings eligible at drought start; no outcome-based exclusion
target_trial.assignment: Hypothetical random allocation to drought versus normal irrigation within prior inoculum strata
target_trial.time_zero: Start of water withholding; conceptual relative origin, calendar date unavailable

strategies.description: Withhold watering for 10 days then resume for 14 days
Irrigate to field capacity three times per week for 24 days

outcome.definition: Day-24 transpiration normalized by needle dry biomass

estimand.population: Drought-experiment eligible potted seedlings across prior inoculum groups
estimand.intercurrent_events: Retain all eligible pots; document death and missing outcomes, no post-treatment survival filtering

target_trial.analysis_plan: Proposed stratified mean contrast; estimator requires allocation and tray-cluster review. No causal estimate produced here.

emulation.eligibility_mapping: Measurements rows represent 280 included seedlings; selection from original cohort is described in methods
emulation.assignment_mapping: treat D/M is known experimental classification; random selection of seedlings does not verify random drought allocation
emulation.time_zero_mapping: Relative drought-start origin; day10 and day24 columns; units.time_zero=NA explicitly records unavailable calendar date
emulation.strategy_mapping: Published regimen known; individual watering/adherence logs unavailable; treatments table intentionally empty
emulation.outcome_mapping: Measurements.trans_24_bio; additional day10 and water potential observations included
emulation.followup_mapping: Methods define 10-day drought and 14-day recovery; individual loss-event records unavailable
emulation.estimand_mapping: Proposed D-M sustained strategy contrast; not an identified causal benchmark
emulation.analysis_mapping: Import and validation only; no effect estimator or ground-truth causal effect
limitations: Tray grouping not recorded in workbook
Time-series sheets lack shared individual IDs
Calendar start and individual watering logs unavailable
Dry needle biomass normalization is part of outcome definition, not a baseline covariate

identification.exchangeability: Drought allocation needs verification; assess pre-existing inoculum strata and seedling selection
identification.positivity: Each prior inoculum group has both D and M in the workbook; model-based overlap still unassessed
identification.consistency: Map prescribed withholding/recovery regimen; verify adherence before sustained-effect estimation
identification.interference: Tray sharing and greenhouse environment may induce correlation; tray IDs unavailable

missing_data_plan: Blank source endpoint cells become NA/unknown; no undocumented cause of missingness is inferred

provenance.source_location: Mycorrhiza_exposure_drought.xlsx, Measurements and Readme; manuscript methods DOI 10.1093/treephys/tpae029
provenance.transformations: Retain source code; one seedling per pot, pot ID aliases individual code; trim category whitespace; convert four specified endpoint columns and prior inoculum category to long form; leave unknown calendar, genotype, cluster and exposure logs missing

extensions.unit_alias: original plant code represents its single-plant pot
